verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community complaint that creating a useful saved search in Jira is painful. It implies Jira ships saved searches, but says nothing about sharing them. JQL querying and multiple views (boards, lists, timeline, calendars) are mentioned, but there is no first-party documentation of saving a filter or sharing it via a link. Missing for 10: first-party docs on saved filters, documented link-based sharing and permissions, and hands-on corroboration that the saved-search workflow is usable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can save a filtered view of work and share it with a link
